nodes.name: ReadRentStandingOrder
nodes.role: read the current rent standing order for the user's account

nodes.name: CheckNextRentDue
nodes.role: determine the next month's rent due date and the amount the lease requires

nodes.name: CompareRentDetails
nodes.role: compare the standing order's amount, payee, and date with the lease's rent due date and amount

nodes.name: ConfirmChangesWithUser
nodes.role: show the user any differences found and get their explicit approval before any change

nodes.name: UpdateRentStandingOrder
nodes.role: change only the fields the user approved to match the rent due for the next month

nodes.name: ReportRentStatus
nodes.role: tell the user whether the rent standing order was already correct or was updated, and what changed
